name: Sensitive Skin
description: Sensitive skin is characterized by a thinner, more reactive barrier that can be easily irritated or inflamed by various factors such as harsh weather conditions, certain ingredients in skincare products, and even stress.
characteristics: Can become flushed or itchy easily
recommended_ingredients: Green tea extract as a natural anti-inflammatory
ingredients_to_avoid: Preservatives like parabens and formaldehyde releasers

morning_routine.purpose: Remove any impurities without stripping the skin.

night_routine.action: Cleanse the skin with the same gentle cleanser used in the morning.
night_routine.purpose: Prep the skin for overnight recovery and repair.

night_routine.action: Apply a hydrating toner to balance pH levels.
night_routine.purpose: Prepare the skin for further application of products.

night_routine.action: Moisturize with a soothing formula containing ingredients like niacinamide or bisabolol.
night_routine.purpose: Lock in moisture and provide protection overnight.

weekly_care: Apply a gentle exfoliant once weekly to remove dead skin cells and promote cell turnover without irritation.
common_mistakes: Using harsh products that can irritate the skin
Over-washing or scrubbing the skin too aggressively
do: Patch test new products before full application
Use fragrance-free and hypoallergenic skincare products
Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water
dont: Avoid using products with irritating ingredients
Don't skip the SPF, even on cloudy days
Do not use products that cause stinging or burning

seasonal_care.summer: Use sunscreen with a physical blocker like zinc oxide to protect against UV rays and minimize irritation.
seasonal_care.winter: Increase hydration with richer moisturizers and consider using humidifiers in dry indoor environments.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Be extra cautious about moisture on the skin; use gentle, oil-free products to avoid clogging pores.

expert_tips: Always consult a dermatologist if you experience severe reactions or persistent issues with your sensitive skin.
Maintain consistent skincare routines and be patient as treatments take time to show results.
